verdict:
KILL entry-now, carried as a WATCH with named triggers. No escalation trigger fires: both benches are FLAT today, no ADVANCE, not held, next print ~2026-11-06 (yfinance-derived, UNCONFIRMED).

THE CLINICAL LIMB SURVIVED THE ATTACK - SAY SO PLAINLY. Red ran the benchmark check itself and conceded it: ronde-cel's 76% CR and 18-month median PFS in 3L+ R/R LBCL beat ZUMA-1 (58% CR, mPFS 5.8mo) and TRANSCEND (53% CR, mPFS 6.8mo), with no Grade >=3 CRS and 97% manufacturing success across 108 patients. The J&J discontinuation that de-rated the class says in J&J's own words it was portfolio prioritisation, not a safety or efficacy signal. Both benches also agree on the one real caveat: these are cross-trial comparisons against unpulled baseline characteristics (double-refractory share, bridging, IPI), so comparability is PLAUSIBLE, not CONFIRMED. That gap is a shared coverage gap, not a finding against the drug.

THE KILL IS THE FINANCING LADDER, AND IT IS ARITHMETIC. Cash and marketable securities were $228-229M at 6/30/26 against a company-stated runway 'into the third quarter of 2027' - which ends BEFORE the 2H-2027 BLA is even filed, let alone a 2028 launch. A 400-patient randomized Phase 3 head-to-head (NCT07188558) just opened on top of the PiNACLE pivotal. The only committed capital is a $150M ATM that is 99% undrawn, sitting over a 24.5M-share float that is 11.33% short, on a stock where diluted shares already went 14.79M -> 24.505M in about thirteen months. Red's prize table is the honest version of the case: on a magic-funding counterfactual the funded prize clears +50% only at peak sales around $550M or better - demanding for a 3L+ entrant into a pool that 2L CAR-T and off-the-shelf bispecifics are shrinking.

WHERE BLUE CORRECTED RED, AND WHY IT SOFTENS BUT DOES NOT REVERSE. Two corrections matter and both must propagate. First, red's finding 5 is REFUTED: Foresite's move from 5.3% to 2.7% is DENOMINATOR growth, not distribution. Blue pulled the prior 13G - 13,683,858 shares in Oct-2024, which is 684,193 after the 1-for-20 reverse split, against 653,328 now, so the position is roughly flat (-4.5%). The founding crossover held through the entire -46% leg. That is neutral, not bearish, and red's 'impaired conviction' framing must not survive into the ledger. Second, blue reduced the strongest kill: the 8-K guides pivotal data mid-2027 inside a runway that runs into Q3-2027, so the pivotal readout and the H2-2026 3L+ update both sit INSIDE the money. 'Every catalyst is gated behind issuance' is wrong - the standard raise-on-data path is open. Blue also caught a real asymmetry in red's prize table: red charged the 400-patient Phase 3 as a ~$200M cost but priced only the shrinking 3L+ label as the prize, excluding the head-to-head superiority optionality that trial exists to buy.

WHY IT IS STILL NO TODAY. Blue's own conclusion is that this is a tranche/size gate rather than a kill - and a tranche gate with no date to tranche against is a no. The binding fact both benches agree on is that the marginal ATM share prices BELOW the prize until a data date exists, and there is no announced date for the H2-2026 3L+ update, the H2H progress update, or the LYL273 end-of-Phase-1 meeting. Add the supply that IS dated: the 2026-07-13 resale S-3 went effective 2026-07-21 registering 1,100,000 ICT Holdings shares - 4.5% of shares outstanding, larger as a share of true float, zero-cost-basis license consideration from Nov-2025, freshly free to sell into a name with a live undrawn ATM beneath it. Red's finding 1 also convicts the triage of mis-binding that filing to the ATM shelf, which is a brief error worth recording. Response taxonomy: financing risk cuts size, timing tranches - and with no date to tranche to, the correct size today is zero.

ONE THING NEITHER BENCH RESOLVED AND IT IS THE ENTRY-SHAPED HOLE: 11.33% short interest went unadjudicated because the conditioning layer was unreachable at both benches. On a 24.5M-share float with a reverse-split microcap flow character, that is squeeze fuel, and the desk has already been burned once overturning a short on exactly this datum. No divergence claim on this name should be made until discovery_state runs.

court.record: batch4 8/15; red 6/blue 7 PARTIALLY OVERTURNED - outcome CONCORDANT ON POSITION. Both benches land on no entry now. Blue OVERTURNED red's smart-money finding outright and REDUCED the strongest kill, then reclassified the ruling from a kill to a tranche/size gate. The classes differ; the position does not, so no discordance trigger fires.

reopen_gates: EVENT (primary): an ANNOUNCED date for the additional PiNACLE 3L+ data, with the ATM substantially pre-drawn above ~$18. The pairing is the point - a date without a pre-draw just means the raise lands after the pop, and a pre-draw without a date is dilution into a vacuum.
EVENT: a partnership or co-development with cost-share, or any non-dilutive capital >= $100M. This is the single cleanest way the financing kill dies.

DATA: the PiNACLE 3L+ baseline table (double-refractory share, bridging, IPI) showing prognosis comparable-or-worse than ZUMA-1. Both benches called this a coverage gap; it is what converts the cross-trial comparison from PLAUSIBLE to load-bearing.

DATA (BLOCKING before any size claim, not before entry): run discovery_state / the conditioning layer on the 11.33% short interest. Neither bench could reach it, so crowding and squeeze fuel are unadjudicated on a 24.5M-share float.
FLOW: evidence the 1.1M-share ICT resale has been absorbed without price damage - the dated supply overhang clears before any catalyst-driven entry.
